response_code_contract.rule: Codes are item-dependent: Q97 9 is postgraduate, Q8A/Q86A 9 is DK, Q97 99 is DK. Unverified codes are UNKNOWN not imputed.

respondent_risk_contract.state_law: Unknown route cannot produce denominator 0 or a scientific absence. Separate eligible / exposed / substantive / no answer / DK / refusal / not asked / unknown. Physical same-row not automatically same person.

design_ceiling.RAW: only exact source sample respondent-descriptive scope if separately source-use authorized; no population extrapolation
design_ceiling.WEIGHTED: positive competent original sample design, national/boost restriction, release-specific weight and calibrated population and variance method and estimand issuer required
design_ceiling.UNKNOWN: uncertainty unquantified; no inferred confidence intervals/standard errors
design_ceiling.CAUSAL: not granted from contemporaneous associations or reported deprivation

permissions.rule: Never inherit new target-use rights from context, source literature or generic runtime capability; issuer/adoption and immutable preimage needed.

a04_c11_projection_mapping.subject: RespondentIdentity + RowRespondentBinding(row_ordinal,respondent_ref), independently grounded on native original unit
a04_c11_projection_mapping.routing: RoutingEligibilityFact per exact item and eligible/asked state
a04_c11_projection_mapping.closure: AuthoritySnapshot + required_authority_refs + projection_authority_ref + replay_authority_ref; predicate/query/use authority separately
a04_c11_projection_mapping.negative: project_c11_candidate_from_physical_cells rejects missing projection, source hash mismatch, unbound response value/state and incomplete projected cells. That validation does NOT issue scientific source meaning.
a04_c11_projection_mapping.handoff: A04 outer join original inventory and permitted operation to this projection; preserve every held item/operation instead of hiding in constructed selection.
